title: The Deligne-Drinfeld conjecture
summary: We prove the Deligne–Drinfeld conjecture: the rational Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra is freely generated by one element in every odd weight at least three, with the corresponding isomorphism after weight completion.

review.reason: Proves the rational Grothendieck–Teichmüller Lie algebra is free on one generator per odd weight.

discussion.title: The Deligne--Drinfeld conjecture after OpenAI
discussion.author: Thomas Willwacher
discussion.text: We provide a simplified and more human-friendly version of the proof of the Deligne--Drinfeld conjecture recently given by OpenAI.

discussion.title: Confluence relations, Hoffman basis over \mathbb{Z}_{(2)}, and the Deligne--Drinfeld conjecture
discussion.author: Minoru Hirose
discussion.text: We express every admissible word as a $\mathbb{Z}_{(2)}$-linear combination of Hoffman words and explicit confluence relations. This implies that every multiple zeta value is a linear combination of elements of the Hoffman basis with coefficients having odd denominators, as conjectured by Hirose…
